html: † הַמְנִיכָא Qr (Kt המינכָא, also [Gi] המוניכא, etc.) n.[m.] chain, necklace (Talm. הַמְנִכָּא DWB 108; Syriac ܗܰܡܢܺܝܟܳܐ; loan-word from Gk. μανιάκης K§ 64, 4; or < Pers. hämyān, girdle [dimin. would be hamyānak] (whence also Gk. μαν., Bev Dr Dn 5:7) AndrM 60 (reading הַמְיָנְֽכָא); v. also Behrm ix Lag Ges Abh. 40; Arm. Stud. 1420; v. Krauss 5 f. (who cp. also Talm. מוּנְיָיק, מָנְיָיק necklace, bracelet, Levy NHWB iii. 52 b, 158 b D 230));—of gold, Dn 5:7, 16, 29.
